Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.

South office window spans approximated from the dimension chain 2190/1200/360/660/1200/2190 pattern; small 360/660mm sub-segments merged/simplified rather than modelled as separate small openings.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: Matches North_view.png dimension chain exactly; consistent with the already-declared F1 window z=[1.0,2.6]m used in the source plan.

claims.reason: North_view.png left vertical dimension chain for the LOWER (F1) storey reads 400,1600,1000 mm from top to bottom, with the top of this sub-chain at the F1/F2 slab datum (world z=3.0m, i.e. F1 ceiling height 3.0m established from the F1/F2 storey split). Walking down (direction=-1) from origin 3.0m: segment0=[2.6,3.0] is the gap above the window head, segment1=[1.0,2.6] is the window opening itself (head=2.6m, sill=1.0m absolute). This chain is shared by all F1 exterior windows (North/South/East facades all show the same 400/1600/1000 breakdown for their single lower window row).
unresolved: East facade F1 window assumed to share this same family since only North/South chains were directly measured; East elevation was viewed but its own vertical dimension chain was not separately transcribed.

decision.reason: Matches North_view.png dimension chain exactly; consistent with the already-declared F2 window z=[4.0,5.8]m used in the source plan.

claims.reason: North_view.png left vertical dimension chain for the UPPER (F2) storey reads 800,1800,1000 mm from the roof/top datum (world z=6.6m, the total building height established from 3.0m F1 + 3.6m F2 storey heights) down to the F1/F2 slab. Walking down (direction=-1) from origin 6.6m: segment0=[5.8,6.6] is the gap above the window head, segment1=[4.0,5.8] is the window opening itself (head=5.8m, sill=4.0m absolute). This chain is shared by all F2 exterior windows.
unresolved: East/West facade F2 windows assumed to share this same family since only North/South chains were directly measured.

after: F1 window height family (sill 1.0m/head 2.6m absolute) confirmed via claim_0001 dimension chain from North_view.png; East facade window assumed to share this family as no separate East vertical dimension chain was transcribed.
